group_manifest.proof_strategy: First add and prove the two group-suffixed pure list helpers by induction. Prove entail_wit_1 by unfolding anchor, recursing over xizi_dll/xizi_dllseg to focus the first member or last sentinel predecessor, and deriving freshness from separated stores. Prove return_wit_1 through return_wit_4 by selecting their full-DLL disjuncts, normalizing the supplied list equalities, locally folding the updated link stores into one/two dllseg layers, appending unchanged segments, and closing xizi_dll. Prove sentinel contract derivation with existential head=linklist_pre and nodes=nodes_sentinel_case, derive sentinel absence from dllseg guards, rewrite with the absent helper, and construct the identity wand. Prove member derivation with existential head=head_member_case and nodes=nodes_member_case; the output assertions are then identical.

Prove return_wit_1 through return_wit_4 by selecting their full-DLL disjuncts, normalizing the supplied list equalities, locally folding the updated link stores into one/two dllseg layers, appending unchanged segments, and closing xizi_dll. group_entry.natural_language_proof_strategy: The C implementation performs one mathematical operation: splice a fresh node before a member, or append it when the anchor is the sentinel. Keep the proof at this list-and-DLL level. The implementation Assert exposes exactly the predecessor/suffix cuts needed by the four returns, while the two public-contract witnesses are identity-wand inclusions after choosing dispatch parameters and normalizing the list function.
group_entry.grouping_reason: One function, one list transform, one DLL predicate family, shared pure helpers, no inter-group dependency, and seven witnesses within the controller limit of 12. A single worker can reuse local segment focus/append and freshness arguments without cross-group helper duplication.
